common: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: Forest Arena transparent RGBA game sprite poses. Reference is identity/style only. Make exactly 16 full-body poses in a strict 4 by 4 grid, row-major chronological order. Every pose faces right. Each character occupies at most 60% of its own cell width and height, with generous transparent gutters on all four sides. No grid lines, text, floor, shadows, detached body fragments or background. Preserve the reference face, costume, palette, proportions and rendering. Never crop any ear, hair, hand, foot or tail. Keep the same character size in all cells. Clear preparation, active and recovery phases.

new_generations.action: One strong horizontal tail sweep to the right. Poses 1-4 brace and wind up, 5-9 swing the single large brown-white striped tail horizontally, 10-12 follow through, 13-16 recover. All 16 cells must contain her COMPLETE human body: face, torso, two arms, two human legs, shoes. Two round weasel ears and ONE tail only. Silver-gray hair, brown-white-black jacket and shorts, teal gems, brown eyes; chibi game rendering, not animal face or paws. Tail may occlude some body naturally but never replace or erase it.

A rising KNEE strike, not an extended-foot low kick. Poses 1-4 guard and step, 5-9 sharply raise the front bent knee upward toward the opponent while balancing on the other leg, 10-12 lower the knee, 13-16 recover into guard. Preserve human hands and legs, exactly two long rabbit ears, short rabbit tail and pink-white costume from the reference.

A LEAPING rotating kick finisher. Poses 1-4 crouch and jump preparation, 5-9 airborne rotating kick, both feet visibly off the ground during the strike, 10-12 descend, 13-16 land and recover into guard. Preserve human hands and legs, exactly two long rabbit ears, short rabbit tail and pink-white costume from the reference.
